cases.original_forecast: A moderate hydroxide dose gives Zn(OH)2; sufficiently strong excess hydroxide can redissolve it into soluble hydroxo-zinc species.

original_criteria.criterion: A zinc-bearing hydroxide solid appears at the intermediate snapshot.
Its amount decreases after excess base while total zinc remains constant; unsupported hydroxo-complex coverage is not a chemical pass.

cases.reason: Original C2 requires a decrease, not clearing or a minimum fraction. A 2.4904% decrease with supported hydroxo-complex distribution and zinc retention is substantive bounded partial redissolution. original_criteria.criterion: The solid inventory falls on acidification and rises again after base addition.
